steps.message: CoreCompile ran and failed with CS0103 because Program.cs references VersionedApp.VersionInfo, but VersionInfo.cs was never generated before compilation. Looking at the project's target list, GenerateVersionInfo is declared with AfterTargets="Build" -- that only runs after the entire Build target (which itself depends on CoreCompile) finishes, so it can never produce the file in time for the same build's compile step. In fact, since CoreCompile fails, Build itself never completes, so GenerateVersionInfo never even executes at all in this run.

The chain is: CoreCompile compiled Program.cs before VersionInfo.cs existed, producing the CS0103 error that the name 'VersionedApp' does not exist, because GenerateVersionInfo is hooked with AfterTargets="Build" and so never runs early enough to write the generated file. Fix: change the target hook from AfterTargets="Build" to BeforeTargets="BeforeCompile" (or "CoreCompile"), and make sure the newly-written VersionInfo.cs is added as a Compile item inside that same target (for example via an ItemGroup with <Compile Include="VersionInfo.cs" />) so CoreCompile actually picks it up before compiling.
